name: ModifyFirewallV2RoutePolicySwitch

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.

Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the operation returns ErrorParameters (-360103)
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时接口返回 ErrorParameters（-360103）
parameters.name: firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the firewall route policy.

Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided or the policy does not exist, the operation returns ErrorTrFirewallPolicyNotFound (-361043). You can call DescribeTrFirewallV2RoutePolicyList to query valid route policy IDs
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙路由策略ID。

注意：本参数实际为必填项；未提供或策略不存在时接口返回 ErrorTrFirewallPolicyNotFound（-361043）。可通过 DescribeTrFirewallV2RoutePolicyList 查询有效的路由策略ID
parameters.name: tr_firewall_route_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the policy switch. Valid values:

open: Enabled.

close: Disabled.

Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided or the value is not within the preceding range, the operation returns ErrorParameters (-360103)
parameters.help_zh:
策略开关。取值：

open：开启

close：关闭

注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供或取值不在上述范围内时接口返回 ErrorParameters（-360103）
parameters.name: tr_firewall_route_policy_switch_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restore the traffic redirection configuration. Valid values:

true: Rolls back the route.

false: Revokes the route
parameters.help_zh:
是否恢复引流配置。取值：

true：路由回滚

false：路由撤销
parameters.name: should_recover
